minutes.headline: Commission lifted the cease-and-desist at the 7-Eleven Mass Ave site and continued 390 Howard Street hearing to January 17.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission heard a Parks update on town beach sand work, approved a garage-addition notice of intent at 22 Fairview Road, and continued several hearings. It lifted a cease-and-desist at the Mass Ave site on a restoration plan, and discussed legal-ad payment problems, the Hollis Road caretaker lease, and enforcement items. The 390 Howard Street delineation hearing was continued after disputes over wetland flags.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted unanimously to lift its cease-and-desist at the 7-Eleven Mass Ave site so a storm sceptor can be installed; the enforcement order stays until restoration planting is done.
The 390 Howard Street wetland delineation hearing was continued to January 17, 2024, after a dispute over flags; a site visit is to be arranged offline.
The Commission approved a notice of intent for a garage addition at 22 Fairview Road, with standard conditions, on a unanimous roll call.
Hearings for Sunny Hill Road, Arbor Street and three Kilber Street lots were each continued, most to January 3.
Legal-ad payment problems were left unresolved; staff are to call the Ledger about the cause and an online payment process, and the Hollis Road caretaker lease also ended without a resolution.

why_it_matters: The cease-and-desist and enforcement order at the Mass Ave site set when stormwater controls can be installed and when the wetland restoration must be finished.
Who pays for legal ads, and how, decides whether a hearing can be held, so applicants' filings and the Land Use office budget are both affected.
The Hollis Road house is town conservation property whose rent and repairs draw on a revolving fund, so the unsettled lease terms bear on a town asset.
watch_next: January 3, 2024: continued hearings for Sunny Hill Road and the three Kilber Street lots.
January 17, 2024: continued 390 Howard Street delineation hearing.
